statements.impact_statement: The advisory requires github.com/klauspost/compress/s2.NewDict and Dict.Encode. The engine retains compress v1.17.8 metadata but distributes no S2 package on disk, in vendor/modules.txt, or in its verified runtime source closure. The VEX verifier rejects any S2 source path, package entry, runtime file, or change to the exact module version.

statements.status_notes: Ratio1 backports the official HTTP/2 initial-window flow-control fix from golang/net commit cc7d34fd2dd5864bcafe3e5e0a84919240be98c0 to vendored v0.56.0. SETTINGS updates perform constant work without traversing active streams, and stream-window overflow is detected lazily. Exact implementation preimages, patched files, and self-contained flow-control regressions are hash-pinned in source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

Ratio1 backports the official secure/precis Nickname short-destination and streaming-checker fix from golang/text commit 02aa981a75cb366b39e71729b935c15a7b4e146a to vendored v0.39.0. The vulnerable package is compiled into the engine; this decision relies on the fix rather than package exclusion. Exact implementation preimages, patched files, and short-buffer plus invalid/partial UTF-8 regressions are hash-pinned in source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects Prometheus's /api/v1/read remote-read handler. R1DB compiles selected labels, parser, storage-interface, and TSDB utility packages, but its verified runtime closure excludes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote and contains no remote-read HTTP handler.

statements.status_notes: Ratio1 backports the maintained negative DataRow field-length check from pgx commit 7f382f5190f58c16f5bd9d60f4443b658a5a3a22. The patched source and direct plus full-frame regressions are hash-pinned in source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

Ratio1 backports the official Apache Thrift Go compact-protocol varint bound from commit d5152211af61f850ec393604316804096dd4632e. Exact implementation preimage, patched source, and boundary regression hashes are enforced by source/ratio1-engine-overrides.json.

Ratio1 backports the official gRPC-Go receive-buffer compaction fix from commit 8cfeca0e1ee5ea0980dcc320e20240fa1079ec77 to the engine's vendored v1.82.1 source. Cloudflared selects upstream-fixed v1.83.2; its verified module sums, source markers, and binary hash enforce the fix without a local patch.

statements.impact_statement: The crash requires the xDS routing interceptor installed by grpc/xds.NewGRPCServer. The verified engine runtime source closure excludes vendor/google.golang.org/grpc/xds/, and the exact Cloudflared compiled-package closure excludes google.golang.org/grpc/xds. The affected xDS server implementation is not compiled into either binary.

The minimal runtime retains only the setsid executable from util-linux. The vulnerable DOS/EBR parser, libblkid, blkid, findmnt, mount, and related libraries and utilities are absent; mount checks read /proc/self/mountinfo directly.

The advisory affects target-path handling in the setuid mount executable for restricted user mounts. The scratch runtime retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux; mount, umount, libmount, /etc/fstab, and the vulnerable restricted-mount path are absent.

The advisory affects privileged post-mount hooks introduced in util-linux v2.39. R1DB retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux v2.38.1; mount, libmount, external mount helpers, and /etc/fstab are absent.
The advisory affects nsenter --join-cgroup, introduced in util-linux v2.40. R1DB retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux v2.38.1; nsenter and its cgroup-joining code are absent.

The advisory affects the detached-tree X-mount.subdir path introduced in util-linux v2.42. R1DB retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux v2.38.1; mount, libmount, /etc/fstab, and the X-mount.subdir implementation are absent.

The advisory affects restricted bind-mount owner, group, and mode hooks introduced in util-linux v2.39. R1DB retains only non-setuid setsid from util-linux v2.38.1; mount, libmount, /etc/fstab, and the X-mount hook implementations are absent.

The vulnerability is confined to analyze_string in the infocmp command. The minimal runtime retains libtinfo for Bash and the database binary but contains no infocmp executable or ncurses command package.

The advisory affects SSH server authentication reached through ssh.NewServerConn. The database engine's v0.53.0 dependency excludes golang.org/x/crypto/ssh from its vendored runtime closure. Cloudflared now embeds fixed x/crypto v0.58.0 and is outside this exact-version exception.
